highlights.full: Recommends a flight only when the odds gap and confidence justify it; otherwise it explains why no winner is named.
Labels every row as flight-specific next-gen odds or an airline-level streaming score so two different measurements cannot look interchangeable.

highlights.home: Automatic single-airline sorting with a real undo
highlights.full: Automatically sorts supported single-airline result pages by next-gen odds and provides a real undo, while preserving host order where automatic sorting is not offered.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Flight-row metrics
allowedFeatureClaims.question: What does this number measure?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: Per-flight odds only for an exposed UA or AS flight number; otherwise a labelled carrier-level ConnectScore.

behaviors.united: Labels UA rows with per-flight next-gen odds and the carrier streaming score.
behaviors.alaska: Labels AS rows with per-flight next-gen odds after optional access is granted.
behaviors.navan: Labels United rows only; other carriers remain carrier-level or unknown.
behaviors.google: Adds carrier scores, upgrading to per-flight UA or AS odds only when Google exposes a flight number.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Best WiFi choice
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Is one flight clearly better supported?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: Names a winner only with at least two scored flights, an eight-point lead, and high or medium tracker confidence.
steps: Name a winner or explain refusal

behaviors.united: Shows a decision card but does not offer the carrier-framed Prioritize control.
behaviors.alaska: Shows a decision card when enough AS evidence clears the gate.
behaviors.navan: Can explicitly prioritize supported United rows while unscored rows follow.
behaviors.google: Shows labelled evidence only; Google owns the result order and no prioritization is offered.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Sorting and undo
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Can the best-supported flight move up safely?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: Automatic sorting is limited to supported single-airline result lists and always preserves a real undo.

behaviors.united: Sorts supported United result lists automatically and offers Keep site order.
behaviors.alaska: Sorts supported Alaska result lists automatically and offers Keep site order.
behaviors.navan: Preserves host order by default because unscored airlines are unknown, not worse.
behaviors.google: Not offered here. Google Flights virtualises its result list and owns its ordering.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Route panel
allowedFeatureClaims.question: What is the evidence across this result page?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: Summarises only rows the current host exposes and states the coverage boundary beside the action.

behaviors.united: Summarises the visible United route and its per-flight evidence.
behaviors.alaska: Summarises the visible Alaska route after optional access is granted.
behaviors.navan: Summarises United rows and says other airlines remain unscored.
behaviors.google: Not offered here. The extension adds row labels without a separate route panel.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Trip Guardian
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Did the assigned aircraft change before boarding?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: Reports the latest grounded assignment state; an unknown aircraft is never rewritten as a negative.
steps: Report the update with its reason

behaviors.united: Watches a saved United flight for a grounded assignment update.
behaviors.alaska: Watches a saved Alaska flight after optional host access is granted.
behaviors.navan: Watches a supported United flight saved from Navan.
behaviors.google: Watches a supported flight saved from Google Flights without changing Google's page order.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Popup coverage and lookup
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Where is the extension active, and what can I look up?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: Shows access state and carrier-level coverage for the shipped release; optional hosts stay off until the user grants them.

behaviors.united: Built-in access; the popup exposes current coverage and lookup.
behaviors.alaska: Access off becomes a user grant, then Alaska coverage turns on.
behaviors.navan: Built-in access; the popup explains United-only per-flight coverage.
behaviors.google: Access off becomes a user grant; carrier scores appear after permission is granted.
